name: Tobari Yousuke
source:
A boy who can't go to school and is a hikikomori. He is modest and hard to understand.

After meeting with a mysterious young girl named Merry, his otherwise dull daily life begins to change.

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/21331760]official website[/url]]
